artGeneration: Original sepia campaign illustration corrected with the pair of harnessed horses visible in the recorded in-game Shu War Chariot; portrait and recorded model used as design references.
sources: Installed War Chariot Focus Fire unit definition and approved Lab registry

paragraphs: In the age of the Three Kingdoms, rival armies struggled for control of a divided China. Shu was the kingdom of Liu Bei, whose story blends history with the legends of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Its War Chariot carries a large crossbow into battle, bringing a concentrated volley of bolts to the front line.
The War Chariot can switch between Focus Fire and Barrage. This episode uses Focus Fire throughout, directing its bolts at a chosen target.
Shu can strengthen these volleys with Bolt Magazine. Keeping enemies at a distance gives this mobile siege weapon time to fire; opponents that close the gap put that firepower to the test.
